The Internet has come to change the way of handling marketing and communication strategies. It has led to the emergence of economically active Internet users online. You have asked yourself: Who are they? Where are they located? To whom do they relate? How and with what do they communicate? What content do they share or generate? To know and interact with them requires having digital marketing strategies.  In our country, there is a great opportunity for development in digital marketing due to the constant growth of clients connected to the Internet.  Digital Marketing was created to teach its participants to take advantage of the Internet and find new customers, position their brand and sell products and services with the use of Web 2.0 tools.

-Elaboration and execution of Marketing and Communication plans in Social Networks. -Planning, execution, and optimization of strategies in Social Networks.  -Role of the CM and its responsibilities.  -Integration of CM activities with the Marketing and Communication departments.  -Acquisition of skills to clearly communicate the interests of the company to its clients.  -Conception of the web beyond a simple web page: turn it into a profitable business.  -Knowledge and understanding of the tools that make work as CM easier.  -Definition of strategies and development of Digital Marketing campaigns.  -Acquisition of knowledge about SEO, SEM, Web Analytics and Social CRM.
Activities: Social media have changed the communication methods between entities and society, the consumer became a consumer who participates in the development of the brand, the reader became a user who interacts with the brand, and society observed how screens are the most powerful influence to send messages.
